meta.title: VTES v5 — Full Game Loop FSM (5 players) — rules-level, card-agnostic

regions.label: META LOOP: Game continues until one Methuselah remains (VP scoring)
ADVANCED: Contest (unique cards & titles) — paid each unlock phase
Minion Phase Core Loop (actions resolve one-by-one)
Bleed Subloop (directed at prey by default; Edge handling)
Block Attempt + Block Resolution FSM (stealth/intercept + impulse + post-block exceptions)
Combat FSM (7-step rounds per v5 rulebook; card-agnostic)
Card Play Micro-FSM (rule-level, applies to any card/effect)
Shared Impulse Window (play/pass loop; timers are ENV-defined) — EXPLICIT ORDER
ENGINE BUILD-TIME: Card Dataset Integration (vtes_v5.json) — non-gameplay loop
RUNTIME: Card Timing Hooks (generalized, used to open impulse windows)

states.label: Start game session
states.detail:
(choose 5 seats clockwise)
Predator=right, Prey=left

states.label: Setup:
states.detail:
• Build crypt+library decks
• Shuffle both decks, cut by predator
• Draw 7 library cards (starting hand)
• Deal 4 crypt cards to uncontrolled region face down
• Initial pool + Edge setup (per rules)
• Choose first Methuselah

states.label: Turn passes clockwise to next Methuselah
Check end condition:
states.detail:
only 1 Methuselah remains
(or table ends)

states.label: Victory Points (VP) update:
states.detail:
• Gain 1 VP when prey is ousted
• Gain +1 VP if last remaining
Winner = highest VP (even if ousted)

states.label: Hand size baseline = 7
states.detail:
Whenever hand size changes or cards are added/removed:
Immediately draw up to, or discard down to, hand size

states.label: Drawing cards (replacement):
states.detail:
Whenever you play a card from hand,
draw 1 from library to replace it
(unless card text says otherwise).
If library empty: you continue playing, but don't draw.

states.label: 1) Unlock Phase
states.detail:
• Unlock all your cards
• Resolve unlock-phase effects
• Handle contests / yields
• (Adv) Optional: burn 1 pool per Infernal minion to unlock
• If you have the Edge, you may gain 1 pool from blood bank

states.label: 2) Master Phase
states.detail:
• Receive master phase actions (MPA)
• Use MPAs (e.g., play master cards)
• Choose ordering vs other master-phase effects
• Unused MPAs are lost

states.label: 3) Minion Phase
states.detail:
• Ready, unlocked minions may take actions
• Mandatory actions first
• Each action fully resolves before next

states.label: 4) Influence Phase
states.detail:
• Receive transfers (normally 4)
• Early-game balancing (5 players):
  seat1 gets 1, seat2 gets 2, seat3 gets 3 transfers on their first influence phase
  (seats 4-5 reach their first influence phase after this)
• Spend transfers to influence/reveal vampires etc.

states.label: 5) Discard Phase
states.detail:
• Receive discard phase action (DPA)
• Use DPA to discard+replace
• (Adv) Use DPA to play event (≤1 per phase; each event only once per game)
• Unused DPA lost

states.label: If unique card/title duplicates enter play -> contest begins
states.detail: All contested copies turn face down (out of play)

states.label: During your unlock phase:
states.detail:
• Pay cost to contest (card: 1 pool; title: 1 blood)
OR
• Yield (burn yielded card / lose title)
• Vampires in torpor must yield contested titles

states.label: If all others yield:
states.detail:
• Your copy unlocks & turns face up during your next unlock
• Contest ends

states.label: Start Influence Phase
states.detail: Set transfers by seat/turn

states.label: Repeat until transfers = 0 (player choice):
states.detail:
• 1 transfer: move 1 pool -> uncontrolled vampire (adds blood)
• 2 transfers: move 1 blood from uncontrolled vampire -> your pool
• 4 transfers + burn 1 pool: move vampire from crypt -> uncontrolled
(plus any other allowed transfer options)

states.label: At any time in this phase:
states.detail:
If uncontrolled vampire blood ≥ capacity:
• move to ready region face up, unlocked
• excess blood returns to blood bank

states.label: End Influence Phase
states.detail: unused transfers lost

states.label: Start Discard Phase
states.detail: Gain DPA

states.label: Use DPA (optional):
states.detail:
A) Discard 1 card -> draw 1
B) (Adv) Play 1 event card (≤1 per phase)

states.label: End Discard Phase
states.detail: unused DPA lost

states.label: Select your next action
states.detail:
(only ready, unlocked minion)
OR end minion phase

states.label: Mandatory actions gate:
states.detail:
• If any of your ready, unlocked vampires have 0 blood,
  they have mandatory HUNT actions.
• While mandatory actions remain, you cannot take non-mandatory actions.
• If multiple mandatory actions exist, choose order.
(Other mandatory actions can exist via card text.)

states.label: Announce action & lock acting minion
states.detail:
• Basic bleed / basic hunt / action card in hand / effect in play
• Set targets (directed/undirected)
• Pay costs (if any)

states.label: Window: 'as action is announced'
states.detail: (only effects explicitly allowed here)

states.label: Block eligibility (rule-level):
states.detail:
• Directed at a Methuselah (e.g., bleed prey): that Methuselah may attempt to block
• Directed at a minion: that minion's controller may attempt to block
• Undirected: prey and predator may attempt to block
(Other cases require card-specific rules; excluded here)

states.label: Resolve block attempts (clockwise)
states.detail:
Each eligible player may attempt with a ready, unlocked minion
(see Block Attempt FSM)

states.label: Action blocked?
states.detail:
YES -> blocked path
NO  -> successful path

states.label: Successful action resolves
states.detail:
Branch by action type:
• Bleed -> Bleed subloop
• Hunt -> Hunt subloop
• Political -> Referendum subloop
• Other -> Resolve per card/effect

states.label: Blocked action cleanup
states.detail: Action is unsuccessful; resolve blocked-action consequences, then end the action

states.label: Action ends
states.detail: If a minion unlocks during this phase (effect), it may act again

states.label: If action is BLEED and is unblocked:
states.detail:
• default bleed amount = 1 (modifiable)
• action modifiers & reactions may modify/redirect/reduce (card-agnostic here)

states.label: Prey burns B pool (if possible)
states.detail: If pool reaches 0 -> oust check

states.label: If B ≥ 1, bleed is successful:
states.detail:
Acting controller gets the Edge
(take from current holder if any)

states.label: Bleed subloop ends -> return to action end
If action is HUNT and is unblocked:
states.detail:
• undirected action
• default stealth +1
• hunt is mandatory at 0 blood

states.label: If successful:
states.detail:
Acting vampire gains hunt amount blood
from blood bank

states.label: Hunt subloop ends -> return to action end
Potential blocker chosen
states.detail: (ready, unlocked minion)

states.label: Window: action modifiers + reactions
states.detail:
• Stealth/Intercept added only if needed
• Same minion cannot play same reaction/modifier more than once per action
• Impulse cycles; any effect returns impulse to acting

states.label: Compare:
states.detail:
if Intercept ≥ Stealth => block succeeds
else => block fails

states.label: Block fails
states.detail:
• return to next blocker opportunity
• action continues

states.label: Block attempt succeeds
states.detail:
(Intercept ≥ Stealth)
=> action becomes blocked (unsuccessful)

states.label: Block resolution (rule)
states.detail:
If action is blocked:
• Any card played to perform the action is burned
• Two simultaneous consequences:
  A) blocking minion locks
  B) blocking minion enters combat with acting minion
Exception (rule-level):
If an effect ends the action before block resolution
OR before consequence B (entering combat),
then neither consequence occurs.

states.label: Did an effect end the action
states.detail:
before block resolution or
before entering combat?

states.label: Action ended early (rule-level)
states.detail:
• Not treated as blocked resolution
• No lock + no combat
• Cleanup per the ending effect

states.label: Post-block / pre-combat window
states.detail:
(only effects usable 'when action is blocked'
or 'before combat begins')
Use shared IMPULSE_WINDOW
Context A (combat/directed@1)
ENV timeouts => auto-PASS

states.label: Enter combat as a result
states.detail: of the successful block?

states.label: Blocked, no combat
states.detail:
(Action unsuccessful)
• blocker locks (already)
• no action effects
• no action cost paid
Continue to blocked-action cleanup

states.label: Special rule: Leave Torpor is blocked
states.detail:
No combat (minions in torpor cannot enter combat).
If blocker is a vampire: optional immediate diablerie opportunity.
If blocker is an ally or declines: action simply fails.

states.label: Combat begins
states.detail:
(acting minion vs opposing minion)
Combat occurs in 1+ rounds.

states.label: Combat card limit:
states.detail:
• The only minion cards that can be played during combat are combat cards.
ADV: Some combat cards are played by minions "not involved in the current combat"; minions controlled by ANY Methuselah can play those cards.
(Non-combatants can play ONLY if the combat card text explicitly allows it.)

states.label: Non-combatant combat-card play (ADV):
states.detail:
A minion not involved in the current combat may play a combat card ONLY if that combat card explicitly says so.
Sequencing is still by impulse during combat:
Acting Methuselah first; once they pass, defending Methuselah; then remaining Methuselahs clockwise (5-player).
If any Methuselah plays an effect, impulse snaps back to the acting Methuselah.

states.label: Start of combat round
states.detail: (Each round has 7 steps)

states.label: 1) Before Range
states.detail:
Play cards/effects usable before range is chosen.
NOTE: 'before range is determined' effects must be played
before the acting minion decides whether to play a maneuver.

states.label: 2) Determine Range
states.detail:
Default = close.
Use maneuvers to change/offset to close or long.
No minion may play two maneuvers in a row.

states.label: Maneuver cycle:
states.detail: Any combatant play a maneuver (alternate)?

states.label: Range is set for this round
states.detail:
(close or long)
(If maneuver came from strike card/weapon:
that also sets the initial strike choice constraint.)

states.label: 3) Before Strikes
states.detail:
Play cards/effects usable after range is set
but before strikes are chosen.

states.label: 4) Strike
states.detail:
Resolve 1+ strike pairs at the same range.
Each pair:
- Acting minion chooses strike
- Opposing minion chooses strike
- Resolve simultaneously (except special cases)

states.label: Strike targeting note:
states.detail:
At long range, a ranged strike may target an opposing retainer
(instead of the opposing minion) if announced when strike is announced.

states.label: Choose Strike (acting)
states.detail:
From: hand strike / weapon / combat card / other strike source.
If maneuver was used from a strike card/weapon this round:
no other strike for the initial strike.

states.label: Resolve Strike Pair
states.detail:
Apply strike effects.
Then proceed to damage resolution.
If a combatant becomes not ready at any point:
round & combat end immediately.

states.label: Additional Strikes (Adv):
states.detail:
Announced/performed only after the first pair.
Acting decides to gain additional strikes before opposing.
Only 1 card/effect to gain additional strikes per round ('limited').
Resolve by repeating Choose+Resolve steps
(only minions with remaining additional strikes act).
All additional strikes occur at the same range.

states.label: 5) Damage Resolution
states.detail:
Two substeps:
A) Prevent damage (play prevention combat cards)
B) Mend damage:
- Vampires burn 1 blood per unprevented damage
- Allies/retainers burn 1 life per unprevented damage

states.label: Combat ends immediately
states.detail:
(if a combatant is no longer ready)
Return to action flow after resolving required steps.

states.label: 6) Press
states.detail:
If both combatants still ready:
Use presses to continue into another round or to end combat.
Combatants may continue playing presses to offset opponent's last press.
No minion may play two presses in a row.

states.label: Press cycle:
states.detail: Uncancelled press to continue exists?

states.label: 7) End of Round
states.detail:
Play end-of-round cards/effects
(after the press step).
Note: This step also occurs even if combat ends prematurely.

states.label: 7) End of Round (premature)
states.detail:
Play end-of-round cards/effects
(after the press step).
Note: Occurs even if combat ends prematurely.

states.label: Combat ends
states.detail: Return to action resolution flow

states.label: Priority within combat steps:
states.detail:
At every combat stage, the acting minion gets first opportunity
before the opposing minion.
Operationally this is handled by impulse:
• Acting Methuselah keeps impulse until they pass.
• Then the defending Methuselah gets impulse.
• Then the remaining Methuselahs get impulse clockwise (5-player).
Other Methuselahs can only act if a card/effect explicitly allows it
(e.g., combat cards playable by minions not involved in the current combat).

states.label: Referendum starts
states.detail:
• Terms set/declared (if political action)
• Then proceed to polling

states.label: Polling step
states.detail:
Impulse cycles; votes/ballots cast in order
• Acting may delay casting until they choose to cast
• Edge holder may burn Edge to gain 1 vote

states.label: If passes: apply terms/effects
states.detail:
If fails: no effect
Note: political action still 'successful' if unblocked even if referendum fails

states.label: Referendum ends -> return to action resolution flow
Minion enters torpor
states.detail: (typically from combat damage)

states.label: Leave Torpor action
states.detail: (only action torpor vampire may take)

states.label: Diablerie (directed action)
states.detail:
Burn vampire in torpor
Diablerie steps are a single unit:
no interruption; effects before/after only

states.label: Immediate diablerie opportunity
states.detail:
(from blocked Leave Torpor)
Not an action (cannot be blocked)

states.label: Blood Hunt referendum
states.detail:
Automatic & immediate after diablerie
Not an action (cannot be blocked)

states.label: If blood hunt passes:
states.detail: Diablerist burned

states.label: If victim older / Red List:
states.detail:
May gain Discipline / trophies
(handled before blood hunt if applicable)

states.label: If Methuselah pool reaches 0 -> ousted
states.detail:
Remove all cards they control from game
Return rivals' owned cards they controlled at end

states.label: If your prey is ousted:
states.detail:
Gain 1 VP
If you are not ousted at same time, gain 6 pool

states.label: (Optional) Withdraw
states.detail:
Announce intention to withdraw
(handled per rules/advanced summary)

states.label: Declare effect fully:
states.detail:
• announce targets/costs/choices
• show card/effect
• card may be temporarily out-of-play until resolution

states.label: Timing: 'as card is played'
states.detail:
ONLY cancel-as-played + wake effects legal
Use ABC sequencing until all pass
(then continue)

states.label: Resolve or cancel:
states.detail:
• if canceled, card effect does not happen
• move card to ash heap or into play upon resolution
• acting regains impulse after any effect resolves

states.label: Replace/draw:
states.detail:
• after 'as played' window closes and card is resolved/canceled
• draw 1 to replace (unless no-replace)
• if library empty: no draw
• enforce HAND_RULE immediately

states.label: OPEN IMPULSE WINDOW
states.detail:
A play window exists at specific FSM steps.
ENV sets a timer per polled player; timeout => auto-PASS.

states.label: Acting Methuselah ALWAYS has impulse first.
states.detail: ('Acting' = player who is currently resolving an action/card/effect)

states.label: Poll current impulse owner:
states.detail:
PLAY 0+ allowed effects/cards OR PASS
(If PLAY happens: resolve it, then acting gets impulse back)

states.label: If PLAY:
states.detail:
1) run Card Play Micro-FSM (declare -> as played -> resolve -> replace)
2) acting immediately regains impulse

states.label: If PASS (or timeout):
states.detail:
advance impulse to the next Methuselah
according to the context-specific order below.

states.label: Context for impulse order
states.detail: (after acting passes)?

states.label: Context A: Combat OR action directed at a single Methuselah
states.detail:
Order after acting passes:
1) Defending Methuselah first
2) Then every other Methuselah in clockwise order
(5-player example: A -> D -> next clockwise after D -> ... -> last)

states.label: Combat-only clarification:
states.detail:
In combat, "defending Methuselah" = the controller of the opposing combatant.
Other Methuselahs only get impulse if the current window allows them to play something (e.g., a combat card explicitly playable by a minion not involved).

states.label: Context B: Action directed at a SET of Methuselahs
states.detail:
Order after acting passes:
1) Those targeted Methuselahs in clockwise order
2) Then every other Methuselah in clockwise order
(Exclude acting from the pass list)

states.label: Context C: Undirected action
states.detail:
Order after acting passes:
1) Prey first
2) Predator second
3) Then every other Methuselah in clockwise order
(5-player example: A -> Prey -> Predator -> Cross1 -> Cross2)

states.label: Give impulse to next Methuselah in the chosen order
states.detail: (if that Methuselah plays, impulse snaps back to acting)

states.label: Has EVERY Methuselah passed
states.detail: consecutively in the CURRENT window?

states.label: CLOSE WINDOW
states.detail: Return to parent FSM step (advance state)
